limitations: CPU reconstructs raw measurements and arithmetic, not GPU model logits.

Historical TRAIN/benchmark exposure remains; MK and Resurface are absent.

upstream.historical_MK_scope: Only frozen historical file hashes are checked; no historical MK scores affect v6 selection.

unit_receipts.packing_scope: CPU verifies recorded GPU test identities/results and allocation arithmetic, not a GPU kernel rerun

criteria.controlled: exact every-token output/packed bytes/FP16 scales/decoded carry
criteria.random_partition: exact full/segmented/tokenwise outputs and final cache
criteria.stored_scale_division: Correctly rounded FP32 quotient before half-away rounding; zero-scale integer0
criteria.stored_scale_denominator: FP32 clipping multiplication then correctly rounded FP32 division before FP16 round-to-even storage
criteria.diagnostic_legacy_emulation: controlled output exact; random every-token carry exact and readout within recurrence-inclusive gamma21/69/69/3 plus FP16-cell and FP32-underflow bound

kernel.scope: Independent CPU audit of recorded GPU oracle/partition/bytes receipts and raw per-token diagnostic forward-error bound; no GPU rerun by auditor.

ranking.rule: Per layer minimum finite complete alternative NLL; fixed alternative order ties; strictly negative delta only; rank(deltaNLL,layer,alternative order)
ranking.interpretation: Single-layer deltas propose combinations; they do not predict additive combined gains

selection.rule: Minimum complete finite exact-budget disjoint TRAIN PPL; exact ties baseline then frozen candidate export order

start_condition.parent_selection: Frozen v8 TRAIN top8, irrespective of validation comparison
start_condition.criterion: Independent full audit passed; finite v8 PPL >=8.25; all integrity guards passed
